This is an appeal filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1984 against the impugned judgment dated 28.11.2022 in Lac No. 110/19 titled Satish Chander Vs. Union of India' seeking enhancement of the compensation in respect of the land acquired in village Pooth Khurd acquired vide Award No. 07/2005-06/DC (NW) dated 12.07.2005.
10.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that the similar matter in respect of acquisition of land village Pooth Khurd is concerned, is pending adjudication in LA.
APP. 226/2018 titled as 'Randir Singh Vs. Union of India' which is already admitted in the category of Regulars.

entities.text: Randir Singh Vs. Union of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 11. Issue notice.
On appellant taking steps within a week, notice may be served upon the respondent through all permissible modes.
Additionally, through the learned standing counsel.

12. List along with LA. APPL. 226/2018 in the category of 'Regulars.'
13.
List before the Joint Registrar for completion of pleadings on 18.07.2023.
